description: Stereo meter for the Daisy Mix chain, showing the signal of the daisy module touching its left edge and passing the running mix on to the right
notes: Each ladder reads from -60dB in steps of 1.5dB, green to -13.5dB, yellow to -1.5dB, and red for the top four steps ending at 4.5dB
Placed against a DC2 strip it shows that strip's own signal, against an AUX it shows that aux group's collected sends, and against a D-MX2 it shows the master mix
The two lamps in the blue DAISY band light when a daisy module is linked on the left and on the right
The ladders stay dark unless a daisy module touches the left edge; the meter reads nothing of its own.
